_what: Run record for the 2026-11-12 live coverage sweep: what was asked for, what the platform refused, and every shape whose omega-predicted header did not turn up in the render. Kept OUT of data/contract/columns/ so none of these strings can be mistaken for a rendered header. A stopped run (complete false) judges header agreement on the shapes it sent, never on the ones it did not.
how: preview_strategy_report via one long-lived mcporter runtime (scripts/mcporter_runtime.mjs, EXTRACTION_TRANSPORT=runtime), read-only, BTC only, 32 columns per custom section, up to 4 sections per call; refused batches bisected to the offending column.
